text:
tara: FYI noticed the Cost Overview card moved a bunch of cache savings to the generic model row. no per-route split after last ingest patch.

eric: can you paste an example event or the quick query you ran?

tara: quick query:
```
SELECT model_sku, route_id, SUM(cache_saved_tokens) AS saved
FROM token_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY model_sku, route_id
ORDER BY saved DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
rows show route_id=\"widget-checkout\" saved=98k but UI shows only model_sku-level row.

yoona: likely the normalizer reduced billing metadata into a single billing_key scalar. we intentionally did that to control cardinality, but it dropped route_id.

eric: plan: change normalizer to emit explicit columns model_sku + route_id into token_ledger and prefer route for attribution when present. gate behind feature flag `ui.costs.per_route`.

tara: UI ask: show Observed vs Attributed columns so the change is transparent during rollout.

yoona: also cap per-card route breakdown to top-5 and bucket rest as \"other\" to avoid explosion.

infra-bot: deploy started for ingest-service @ 2025-11-12T09:12:00Z

eric: tests: unit for aggregator splitting two events with same model_sku but different route_id; e2e that flips feature flag and asserts extra column appears.

tara: will open PR and include backfill plan for last 7 days into attributed_route column. will add small spike alert if tenant attribution shifts >20% post-rollout.

yoona: thanks. keep the UI toggle default-off until backfill completes. ping when PR is up.
